doc.title: Epic 3 Vaadin Frontend - Story 3.7
doc.section: Policy List Page with Vaadin Grid
doc.snippet: Similar to customer list but for policies with type filtering. Vaadin Grid showing policies. Filter by type (Motor, Endowment, House, Commercial). Filter by status (Active, Renewed, Lapsed). Linked customer column. Action buttons: View, Edit, Delete.

doc.title: Epic 3 Stories Summary - Story 3.7
doc.snippet: Vaadin Grid showing policies with columns: ID, Customer, Type, Status, Premium, Created. Filter by type and status dropdowns. Search by policy number or customer name. Sortable columns, pagination (20 per page).

constraint.title: Grid Pattern Consistency
constraint.description: Follow same Vaadin Grid pattern as Story 3.4 (Customer List) for consistency. Use similar search form structure, filter dropdowns, pagination controls, and responsive layout.

constraint.title: Lazy Data Loading
constraint.description: Use lazy data provider pattern to efficiently handle potentially large policy datasets. Grid should not load all policies at once. Implement ClientSortedProvider or ServerSortedProvider for sorting.

constraint.title: Policy Type Display
constraint.description: Display policy types as abbreviations (M=Motor, E=Endowment, H=House, C=Commercial) with full name in tooltip for space efficiency. Use PolicyType enum for filter dropdown options.

constraint.title: Customer Link Integration
constraint.description: Customer Name column should display customer name as clickable link (RouterLink) to customer detail page if needed. Requires customer ID in policy API response.

constraint.title: Filter Defaults
constraint.description: Status and Type filter dropdowns must default to "All" to show all results initially. Policy List can be searched/filtered or browsed without initial search.

constraint.title: API Query Parameters
constraint.description: API call must pass: search (policy number or customer name), type (policy type filter), status (policy status filter), page (0-indexed), size (20 records per page), sortBy, sortOrder.

constraint.title: Material Design 3 Styling
constraint.description: Apply Material Design 3 theme consistent with other Vaadin pages. Status badges should use color (if used). Icons for sort direction indicators. Responsive spacing and sizing.

constraint.title: Responsive Design
constraint.description: Full-width grid on mobile. Consider collapsing columns on small screens if needed (optional, but recommended). Touch-friendly button sizes. Vertical scrolling for wide tables.

constraint.title: Accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA
constraint.description: Proper labels on form inputs. Grid with proper headers. Keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape). Focus indicators visible. Aria labels where appropriate.

constraint.title: Navigation to Detail
constraint.description: Row click or View action must navigate to Story 3.8 (Policy Detail page). Use Vaadin Router to navigate to /policies/{policyId}.

interface.name: Policy List Search API
interface.description: Primary API for loading policy grid data. Returns paginated results with total count. Supports search by policy number or customer name, filtering by type and status, sorting, and pagination.

interface.name: Vaadin Grid
interface.description: Main data table component. Supports lazy loading, sorting, column resizing. Populate with policy data from API.

interface.name: Vaadin Router
interface.description: Navigation from row click to Policy Detail page (/policies/{policyId}). Route for Policy List page: @Route("/policies")

interface.name: ComboBox (Filter Dropdowns)
interface.description: Filter dropdown components for type and status. Populated with enum values. Default selection "All" (null or special ALL value).

tests.standards: Integration tests calling backend GET /api/v1/policies endpoint with various query parameters. Manual UI testing for search, filtering, sorting, pagination. API mock testing with @MockBean. Responsive design tested on multiple breakpoints. Performance testing to ensure < 2s load time and smooth rendering of 20 rows.
